title: Final: the smart building
sub: IFC, coordination and BCF: test yourself
cards/0/task: Filter for the windows on the second floor.
cards/1/q: How is IFC different from a GLB with the same geometry?
cards/1/options/0: In IFC, objects have a type, a storey, properties and relationships
cards/1/explain: GLB knows what it looks like. IFC knows what it is.
cards/2/task: Find all clashes with a 150 mm clearance.
cards/3/q: Which line is the wall itself?
cards/3/explain: IFCWALL with a GlobalId. #130 is its geometry, #140 is a property.
cards/4/q: Why does IFC open in both Revit and Archicad?
cards/4/options/0: It is the open standard ISO 16739
cards/4/explain: IFC was created precisely for exchange between different programs.
cards/5/q: Which of these are closed native formats? Select all.
cards/5/explain: IFC and BCF are open buildingSMART standards.
cards/6/q: A coordinator wants to tell an engineer “there is a pipe in this beam”. What do they send?
cards/6/options/0: A BCF issue with a camera and GlobalIds
cards/6/options/2: A screenshot in a chat app with no element references
cards/6/explain: BCF opens exactly that view for the engineer and highlights the right elements.
cards/8/pairs/3/1: How to find an object in any program
